predecessors.name: Eretnids
predecessors.text: Erzincan, held by Ahi Ayna as a vassal of Eretna from c.

successors.name: Qara Qoyunlu
successors.text: Erzincan taken by Qara Yusuf in 1410

ledger.x: 1379: Mutahharten takes power at Pir Husayn's death and declares independence at Erzincan.
c. 1395: Kadi Burhan al-Din granted the Bayburt territory to the Aq Qoyunlu; counterpart is not on the map.
1410: Qara Yusuf takes Erzincan after a 45-day siege (Hafiz-i Abru); sources disagree.

certainty.note: No boundaries on the page; Ottoman capture of Erzincan in 1401 and brief imprisonment of Mutahharten are not drawn separately.
